briefdescription.para: Create the logical session for this connection (mandatory, one-shot).

detaileddescription.para: Must be called exactly once after Connect and before CreateAgent or any model-management/storage/voice call — those are rejected with SessionNotReady until the session exists. A second call is rejected by the server with SessionAlreadyExists. On success the server-allocated session id becomes available via GetSessionId.

parameterdescription.para: On server-reported errors or timeout.

briefdescription.para: Change the session language without tearing the session down.

detaileddescription.para: Same BCP-47 grammar as SessionConfig::locale; an empty string clears the locale, restoring pre-locale behaviour everywhere.

Applies to every agent, existing and future, from its next turn: TTS language and the locale template keys are read per turn, not captured. A new voice input picks up the new STT language hint; one already open keeps its recognizer. Storage paths re-resolve on the next load, but content already bound to a node (a Retrieve KB, canned lines) does NOT swap - those params are structural. Use this for the voice + template half of a language change; switching authored content still means recreating agents.
Not turn-atomic: a turn already running may render its prompt under the old locale and synthesize under the new one. Send it between turns if that matters.

parameterdescription.para: On a malformed tag (InvalidLocale, 2004) or timeout.

briefdescription.para: Report how hard the server should yield the GPU back to the game (the manual inference throttle knob).

detaileddescription.para: Fire-and-forget: no response, no error surfaced locally. Never sent automatically — a session that never calls this runs unthrottled, identically to a client on an older protocol version.

parameterdescription.para: 0 = full speed (default), 1 = maximum yielding. Clamped server-side; out-of-range values do not throw here.

Where to put this model, for this load only, overriding any per-model hint given at CreateSession. std::nullopt (the default) means "no opinion" — the session's hint applies. Passing MemoryPlacement_Auto is therefore a real override meaning "host policy", distinct from not asking. Still a hint: an unsatisfiable value is downgraded, not an error — check the returned LoadModelResult.

briefdescription.para: Send a dev-only debug command to the server and report the outcome.

detaileddescription.para: The server handles this only in non-Production builds with debug_commands.enabled. command is a verb (e.g. "crash"); for crash, payload is the mode token (nullderef / abort / throw / throw_posted / stackoverflow / fastfail; empty defaults to nullderef).

Waits up to timeout for one of: the connection dropping (a fatal verb succeeded → disconnected), an ErrorResponse (e.g. the channel is disabled → errorCode set), or a DebugCommandResponse (acknowledged). Does not throw on a server error — inspect the returned struct instead.
